ucs.title: [LLM] APT41 web-facing exploitation → China Chopper webshell → certutil/bitsadmin ingress tool transfer
ucs.description: Hunts the APT41 (Wicked Panda / BARIUM / Brass Typhoon) signature initial-access chain: opportunistic exploitation of internet-facing servers (Citrix, Cisco, ZK/Log4j, MySQL) followed by an IIS/Tomcat/PHP worker process spawning a command interpreter (China Chopper) that then pulls second-stage tooling via certutil or bitsadmin. The webserver-as-parent → LOLBin-download pivot is what distinguishes APT41 mass-exploitation from a normal admin shell.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","tomcat*.exe","java.exe","sqlservr.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","nltest.exe","curl.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| where NOT match(user,"\$$") 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat8.exe","java.exe","sqlservr.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","nltest.exe","curl.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"     // drop machine accounts / SYSTEM noise
| extend IngressToolTransfer = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","-urlcache","/transfer","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          IngressToolTransfer, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","php-cgi.exe","tomcat","java.exe","sqlservr.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","net.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","nltest.exe","curl.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend IngressToolTransfer = CommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","-urlcache","/transfer","DownloadString","Invoke-WebRequest")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, IngressToolTransfer
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT41 Web Server Process Spawning Shell or Ingress LOLBin
id: 7c2f1d4a-9b3e-4c8a-bf21-3e9a1c4d8e21
status: experimental
description: Detects an internet-facing web/app/db server worker process spawning a command interpreter or download LOLBin, matching APT41 webshell-to-ingress tradecraft.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\php-cgi.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\sqlservr.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate web-app deployment or admin scripting invoked by the app pool identity
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1105
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\w3wp.exe OR *\W3WP.EXE OR *\httpd.exe OR *\php-cgi.exe OR *\tomcat*.exe OR *\java.exe OR *\sqlservr.exe) @Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\BITSAdmin.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\whoami.exe OR *\nltest.exe OR *\curl.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(w3wp|httpd|nginx|php-cgi|tomcat\d*|java|sqlservr)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil|bitsadmin|cscript|wscript|net|net1|whoami|systeminfo|nltest|curl)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]))
ucs.rationale: APT41 is repeatedly documented (FireEye/Mandiant M-Trends, CISA AA20-275A) mass-exploiting internet-facing apps and dropping China Chopper webshells, then immediately using certutil/bitsadmin for second-stage transfer. ucs.title: [LLM] APT41 post-exploitation credential dumping: SAM/SYSTEM hive export, comsvcs MiniDump & ntdsutil IFM
ucs.description: Hunts APT41's characteristic credential-harvesting toolkit once on-host: `reg save` of HKLM\SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY, LSASS memory dump via rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump or ProcDump, and ntdsutil IFM extraction of NTDS.dit. APT41 pairs OS-credential dumping with their valid-account lateral movement, so these are the bridge between their webshell foothold and domain-wide RDP/SMB spread.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="reg.exe" AND Processes.process="*save*" AND (Processes.process="*\\sam*" OR Processes.process="*\\system*" OR Processes.process="*\\security*")) OR (Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" AND (Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*#24*")) OR ((Processes.process_name="procdump.exe" OR Processes.process_name="procdump64.exe") AND Processes.process="*lsass*") OR (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` 
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` 
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "reg.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "save" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"hklm\sam", @"hklm\system", @"hklm\security"))
     or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24"))
     or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "lsass")
     or (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "reg.exe" and CommandLine has "save" and CommandLine has_any ("hklm\\sam", "hklm\\system", "hklm\\security"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll" and CommandLine has_any ("minidump", "#24"))
     or (CommandLine has "lsass" and NewProcessName has "procdump")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "ntdsutil.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT41 OS Credential Dumping via Reg Hive Export, comsvcs MiniDump or ntdsutil IFM
id: 1d8b6f23-4a72-49e1-9c0b-2f6e7a3b5c10
status: experimental
description: Detects SAM/SYSTEM/SECURITY hive export, LSASS dumping via comsvcs.dll or ProcDump, and ntdsutil IFM NTDS extraction, matching APT41 credential-access tooling.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  reg_hive:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'save'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'hklm\sam'
      - 'hklm\system'
      - 'hklm\security'
  comsvcs_dump:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs.dll'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - '#24'
  procdump_lsass:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'lsass'
  ntds_ifm:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
  condition: reg_hive or comsvcs_dump or procdump_lsass or ntds_ifm
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup/IR tooling or DC promotion maintenance
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1003.002
  - attack.t1003.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\reg.exe OR *\REG.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*save* AND (*sam* OR *system* OR *security*))) OR (@Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *comsvcs.DLL*) AND @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *#24*)) OR (@Image:(*\procdump.exe OR *\procdump64.exe OR *\ProcDump.exe) AND @CommandLine:*lsass*) OR (@Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *"create full"*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i CommandLine=/save/i CommandLine=/hklm\\(sam|system|security)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i CommandLine=/comsvcs\.dll/i CommandLine=/(minidump|#24)/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\procdump(64)?\.exe$/i CommandLine=/lsass/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i CommandLine=/(ifm|create full)/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName], function=collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]))
